events.text: Abraham Lincoln proclaims Thanksgiving a national holiday.
The Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes is renamed Yugoslavia.
Iraq gains independence from the United Kingdom.
Germany carries out the first successful launch of a V-2 rocket.
The United Kingdom tests its first atomic bomb off Australia.
East and West Germany are reunified.
O. J. Simpson is found not guilty of murder.

births.text: Stevie Ray Vaughan, American blues guitarist
